title: SBI Air India Signature credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: An Air India Signature variant providing elevated Flying Returns miles, business-class upgrade vouchers, and lounge access for premium travelers.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Lost card liability protection of 1 lakh applicable from 48 hours prior to 7 days post reporting about the card to the bank.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Visit https://www.sbigeneral.in/claim to claim your insurance
